shared_elements: row of repeated human figures shown in profile facing the same direction
vertical mast/pole-like element rising above the row
figures rendered schematically with uniform repetition
justification: Both show a horizontal row of nearly identical human figures in profile, all facing one way, with a vertical pole/mast element rising above the row, which gives a loosely comparable frieze-like arrangement. But A depicts a sailing ship with hull, rigging and a sail-like gridded field, its crew reduced to tiny stick-like heads and strokes, whereas B shows large, fully modelled marching men with detailed helmets, garments and legs beside a wheeled/seated structure; the manner of depiction (linear schematic outline vs. rounded naturalistic relief) and the actual subject differ fundamentally.
